d: Bihar ki rajdhani patna men draivar esosieshan oph bihar ke aahvan par hajaron ki sankhya men vahan chalak apni 10 sutri mangon ko lekar sarak par utar aae hain. pradarshan ke lie bari sankhya men draivar patna ke gandhi maidan men ekatr hue. pradarshankariyon ne chetavni dete hue kaha ki ve apna hak lekar hi jaenge, nahin to mukhyamantri ko aavas se nikalne nahin denge.
